extension.summary: Stream your TorBox cloud (torrents, usenet, web downloads) in Kodi
extension.description: Browse and play files from your TorBox account. Supports torrents, usenet and web downloads, adding magnets, deleting items, instant-cache checks, and optional Prowlarr/Jackett search. Requires a TorBox account and API key from torbox.app/settings.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial add-on. Requires your own TorBox account. You are responsible for the content you access.

extension.summary: Movies, TV, anime, K-dramas and music from your TorBox cloud
extension.description: Browse and play movies, TV shows, anime (dub/sub), K-dramas and music through your TorBox account. Search with Torrentio, Nyaa, CocoScrapers, Torznab/Prowlarr and more, open season packs and albums, manage your TorBox torrents, usenet and web downloads, plus Cocoleech. Requires your own TorBox account and API key from torbox.app/settings.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial add-on. Requires your own TorBox account. You are responsible for the content you access.
